narrative: The penny almanac open on the hall table, morning light across the leaf. A right hand holds the corner. Ink is dried on the forefinger. No face. The same leaf. The hand has not taken up a pen. The three lines stay as they were written. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Held the leaf open and did not write.
